residual_risk: The doctor check reads only the board's open+recently-closed issues (boardOnce), the same sample checkAgentLabels uses -- a card that set kb.skills long ago and has since scrolled out of both windows would not be flagged.

The check only understands Skill as a Claude Code concept: it is skipped for any profile whose launch[0] is not 'claude', so a future harness that also reads kb.skills but denies its own equivalent tool would need its own check.

The wiki has a pre-existing 13-page staleness backlog (from unrelated files changed since the last refresh) that this PR does not touch; /repolore:refresh is still owed and was outside this card's scope.

results.summary: Skill is now in CLAUDE_TOOLS (src/board.js), so a task's kb.skills grants what it advertises on every default Claude profile instead of naming a tool dontAsk is guaranteed to deny. hkb doctor gained a `task skills` check (checkTaskSkills/TASK_SKILLS_CHECK, src/doctor.js) that warns per-card when kb.skills is set but the profile's allowed_tools still omits Skill -- catches a board.json frozen before this fix or a custom profile that never had it; silent when no card sets kb.skills, and skipped for non-Claude launches (Codex/Copilot) where Skill has no meaning. hkb create's usage text now says --skills grants the tool on hkb's default profiles and names the fix for a custom one. Regenerated .github/workflows/kanban-worker-claude.yml (hkb init --with-actions) so its baked --allowedTools carries Skill too. Draft PR #221.
